shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dock, title chip, drawer and tooltips floating over the map.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Press, hover and tooltip transitions; shortened to nothing under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; color: var(--on-accent); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action on a tinted surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field with a 1.5px line border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; font: inherit; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.6rem; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container on the page background.
components.html:
Your worlds

You are not part of any world yet.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.3 0.04 175 / 0.1), 0 8px 24px oklch(0.3 0.04 175 / 0.12); } .ds-card p { margin: 0.4rem 0 0; color: var(--text-2); }

components.name: Tool Dock
components.description: Floating near-black tool bar; the active tool is amber.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.2rem; padding: 0.35rem; background: var(--chrome); border-radius: 1.2rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0.1 0.01 180 / 0.3), 0 12px 32px oklch(0.1 0.01 180 / 0.35); } .ds-tool { padding: 0.45rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--on-chrome-2); background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { color: var(--on-chrome); background: var(--chrome-2); } .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--on-dice); background: var(--dice); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--dice); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Drawer Tab
components.description: Icon-and-name tab on the near-black strip.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; width: 4.1rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.4rem; background: var(--chrome); border-radius: 1.25rem; } .ds-tab { padding: 0.55rem 0.1rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--on-chrome-2); background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--on-chrome); background: var(--chrome-2); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--on-accent); background: var(--accent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--dice); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-roll { padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; color: var(--on-chrome); background: var(--chrome); border-radius: 0.3rem 0.9rem 0.9rem 0.9rem; } .ds-notation { margin: 0; font: 0.8rem ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; color: var(--on-chrome-2); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; } .ds-die { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--dice); border: 2px solid var(--dice); border-radius: 0.7rem; } .ds-total { margin-left: auto; font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--dice); }

narrative.overview:
The table is the star. The map fills the whole screen and everything else is furniture around it: a title chip, a tool dock and a drawer of panels, all floating above the map and all willing to step aside. The interface is welcoming and communal, written for someone who has never opened a virtual tabletop, and it avoids clichéd fantasy styling entirely (no parchment, no ornate type). It gets playful only where play happens: dice, tokens and panels move.

The system is a committed color field of teal. Teal is the brand and drives actions and focus; amber is reserved for dice and the active tool; a near-black "chrome" holds the floating pieces in both themes so they read over any map art. Shapes are round, type is the platform's own rounded system face, and nothing relies on knowing VTT conventions.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed map with floating chrome; the drawer hides to give the map the full width.
Teal for action and focus, amber for dice and the active tool, nothing else competes.
Always-dark chrome (dock, title chip, drawer tab strip, roll cards) in light and dark themes.
Pill buttons, rounded containers, chat bubbles, tabs with icon and name.
Tone of text: plain, friendly, second person; "game master" and "player" are spelled out.
Light and dark follow the browser (prefers-color-scheme).

rules.name: The Amber Is Dice Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on dice, roll totals and the active tool. If something is amber, it is about rolling or about what the cursor will do.

rules.name: The Chrome Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: Floating chrome is near-black in both themes. It sits on top of unknown map art, so it must not depend on the page theme.

rules.name: The Four-and-a-Half Rule
rules.body: Text clears 4.5:1 against its background in both themes; that is why links use accent-text on the page background.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers are tabular everywhere (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on the root).

rules.name: The Float Over Map Rule
rules.body: Anything over the map uses the Float shadow; anything on a page background uses the Card shadow. They are not mixed.

dos: Do keep the map the largest thing on screen; chrome is small, floating and dismissible.
Do use teal for actions and focus, and amber only for dice and the active tool.
Do write state out as well as coloring it (online state, hidden tokens, dropped dice, natural 20 and 1).
Do keep 4.5:1 contrast in both themes, a visible 3px focus ring, and 44px touch targets.
Do use the Radix wrappers in components/ui/ for tabs, tooltips and future dialogs, popovers, menus and toasts; keep native select, input and checkbox.
Do write copy in plain second person and spell out "game master" and "player".
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion; animations are decorative.
donts: Don't use parchment, ornate or fantasy display fonts, or any clichéd fantasy styling.
Don't copy the look, naming or layout of other VTTs.
Don't put information in hover only, or in color only.
Don't make the chrome follow the page theme; it stays near-black over the map.
Don't hand-style a raw button or input in a screen; use the primitive or the shared element styles.
Don't add a named CSS class until the same utility set repeats three times (or the markup is generated).
